ayahs.en: The Most Merciful
ayahs.e2: The Most Compassionate

ayahs.en: Taught the Qur'an
ayahs.e2: taught the Quran

ayahs.en: Created man
ayahs.e2: created humanity

ayahs.en: [And] taught him eloquence
ayahs.e2: ˹and˺ taught them speech

ayahs.en: The sun and the moon [move] by precise calculation
ayahs.e2: The sun and the moon ˹travel˺ with precision

ayahs.en: And the stars and trees prostrate
ayahs.e2: The stars and the trees bow down ˹in submission˺

ayahs.en: And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance
ayahs.e2: As for the sky, He raised it ˹high˺, and set the balance ˹of justice˺

ayahs.en: That you not transgress within the balance
ayahs.e2: so that you do not defraud the scales

ayahs.ar: وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلۡوَزۡنَ بِٱلۡقِسۡطِ وَلَا تُخۡسِرُواْ ٱلۡمِيزَانَ
ayahs.en: And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance
ayahs.e2: Weigh with justice, and do not give short measure
ayahs.tr: Wa aqeemul wazna bilqisti wa laa tukhsirul meezaan

ayahs.en: And the earth He laid [out] for the creatures
ayahs.e2: He laid out the earth for all beings

ayahs.en: Therein is fruit and palm trees having sheaths [of dates]
ayahs.e2: In it are fruit, palm trees with date stalks
ayahs.tr: Feehaa faakihatunw wan nakhlu zaatul akmaam

ayahs.en: And grain having husks and scented plants
ayahs.e2: and grain with husks, and aromatic plants

ayahs.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.e2: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you ˹humans and jinn˺ both deny

ayahs.en: He created man from clay like [that of] pottery
ayahs.e2: He created humankind from ˹sounding˺ clay like pottery

ayahs.ar: وَخَلَقَ ٱلۡجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجࣲ مِّن نَّارࣲ‏
ayahs.en: And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire
ayahs.e2: and created jinn from a ˹smokeless˺ flame of fire
ayahs.tr: Wa khalaqal jaaan mim maarijim min naar

ayahs.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.e2: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.en: [He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets
ayahs.e2: ˹He is˺ Lord of the two easts and the two wests

ayahs.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.e2: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.en: He released the two seas, meeting [side by side]
ayahs.e2: He merges the two bodies of ˹fresh and salt˺ water

ayahs.en: Between them is a barrier [so] neither of them transgresses
ayahs.e2: yet between them is a barrier they never cross

ayahs.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.e2: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.en: From both of them emerge pearl and coral
ayahs.e2: Out of both ˹waters˺ come forth pearls and coral
ayahs.tr: Yakhruju minhumal lu 'lu u wal marjaanu

ayahs.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.e2: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.ar: وَلَهُ ٱلۡجَوَارِ ٱلۡمُنشَـَٔاتُ فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ كَٱلۡأَعۡلَٰمِ
ayahs.en: And to Him belong the ships [with sails] elevated in the sea like mountains
ayahs.e2: To Him belong the ships with raised sails, sailing through the seas like mountains
ayahs.tr: Wa lahul jawaaril mun sha'aatu fil bahri kal a'laam

ayahs.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.e2: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.en: Everyone upon the earth will perish
ayahs.e2: Every being on earth is bound to perish

ayahs.ar: وَيَبۡقَىٰ وَجۡهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلۡجَلَٰلِ وَٱلۡإِكۡرَامِ
ayahs.en: And there will remain the Face of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor
ayahs.e2: Only your Lord Himself, full of Majesty and Honour, will remain ˹forever˺
ayahs.tr: Wa yabqaa wajhu rabbika zul jalaali wal ikraam

ayahs.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.e2: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.ar: يَسۡـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ كُلَّ يَوۡمٍ هُوَ فِي شَأۡنࣲ‏
ayahs.en: Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is bringing about a matter
ayahs.e2: All those in the heavens and the earth are dependent on Him. Day in and day out He has something to bring about
ayahs.tr: Yas'aluhoo man fissamaawaati walard; kulla ywmin huwa fee shaan

ayahs.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.e2: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.en: We will attend to you, O prominent beings
ayahs.e2: We will soon attend to you ˹for judgment˺, O two multitudes ˹of jinn and humans˺

ayahs.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.e2: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.ar: يَٰمَعۡشَرَ ٱلۡجِنِّ وَٱلۡإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسۡتَطَعۡتُمۡ أَن تَنفُذُواْ مِنۡ أَقۡطَارِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَٱنفُذُواْۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلۡطَٰنࣲ‏
ayahs.en: O company of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass. You will not pass except by authority [from Allah]
ayahs.e2: O assembly of jinn and humans! If you can penetrate beyond the realms of the heavens and the earth, then do so. ˹But˺ you cannot do that without ˹Our˺ authority
ayahs.tr: Yaa ma'sharal jinni wal insi inis tata'tum an tanfuzoo min aqtaaris samaawaati wal ardi fanfuzoo; laa tanfuzoona illaa bisultaan

ayahs.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.e2: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.ar: يُرۡسَلُ عَلَيۡكُمَا شُوَاظࣱ مِّن نَّارࣲ وَنُحَاسࣱ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ
ayahs.en: There will be sent upon you a flame of fire and smoke, and you will not defend yourselves
ayahs.e2: Flames of fire and ˹molten˺ copper will be sent against you, and you will not be able to defend one another
ayahs.tr: Yursalu 'alaikumaa shuwaazum min naarifiw-wa nuhaasun falaa tantasiraan

ayahs.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.e2: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.ar: فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتۡ وَرۡدَةࣰ كَٱلدِّهَانِ
ayahs.en: And when the heaven is split open and becomes rose-colored like oil
ayahs.e2: ˹How horrible will it be˺ when the heavens will split apart, becoming rose-red like ˹burnt˺ oil
ayahs.tr: Fa-izan shaqqatis samaaa'u fakaanat wardatan kaddihaan

ayahs.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.e2: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.ar: فَيَوۡمَئِذࣲ لَّا يُسۡـَٔلُ عَن ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ إِنسࣱ وَلَا جَآنࣱّ‏
ayahs.en: Then on that Day none will be asked about his sin among men or jinn
ayahs.e2: On that Day there will be no need for any human or jinn to be asked about their sins
ayahs.tr: Fa-yawma'izil laa yus'alu 'an zambiheee insunw wa laa jaann

ayahs.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.e2: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.ar: يُعۡرَفُ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ بِسِيمَٰهُمۡ فَيُؤۡخَذُ بِٱلنَّوَٰصِي وَٱلۡأَقۡدَامِ
ayahs.en: The criminals will be known by their marks, and they will be seized by the forelocks and the feet
ayahs.e2: The wicked will be recognized by their appearance, then will be seized by ˹their˺ forelocks and feet
ayahs.tr: Yu'raful mujrimoona biseemaahum fa'yu'khazu binna waasi wal aqdaam

ayahs.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.e2: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.ar: هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِي يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ
ayahs.en: This is Hell, which the criminals deny
ayahs.e2: ˹They will be told,˺ “This is the Hell which the wicked denied.”
ayahs.tr: Haazihee jahannamul latee yukazzibu bihal mujrimoon

ayahs.en: They will go around between it and scalding water, heated [to the utmost degree]
ayahs.e2: They will alternate between its flames and scalding water
ayahs.tr: Yatoofoona bainahaa wa baina hameemim aan

ayahs.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.e2: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.en: But for he who has feared the position of his Lord are two gardens
ayahs.e2: And whoever is in awe of standing before their Lord will have two Gardens
ayahs.tr: Wa liman khaafa maqaama rabbihee jannataan

ayahs.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.e2: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.en: Having [spreading] branches
ayahs.e2: ˹Both will be˺ with lush branches

ayahs.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.e2: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.en: In both of them are two springs, flowing
ayahs.e2: In each ˹Garden˺ will be two flowing springs

ayahs.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.e2: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.en: In both of them are of every fruit, two kinds
ayahs.e2: In each will be two types of every fruit

ayahs.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.e2: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.ar: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ فُرُشِۭ بَطَآئِنُهَا مِنۡ إِسۡتَبۡرَقࣲۚ وَجَنَى ٱلۡجَنَّتَيۡنِ دَانࣲ‏
ayahs.en: [They are] reclining on beds whose linings are of silk brocade, and the fruit of the two gardens is hanging low
ayahs.e2: Those ˹believers˺ will recline on furnishings lined with rich brocade. And the fruit of both Gardens will hang within reach
ayahs.tr: Muttaki'eena 'alaa furushim bataaa'inuhaa min istabraq; wajanal jannataini daan

ayahs.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.e2: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.ar: فِيهِنَّ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرۡفِ لَمۡ يَطۡمِثۡهُنَّ إِنسࣱ قَبۡلَهُمۡ وَلَا جَآنࣱّ‏
ayahs.en: In them are women limiting [their] glances, untouched before them by man or jinni
ayahs.e2: In both ˹Gardens˺ will be maidens of modest gaze, who no human or jinn has ever touched before
ayahs.tr: Feehinna qaasiratut tarfi lam yatmishunna insun qablahum wa laa jaaann

ayahs.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.e2: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.en: As if they were rubies and coral
ayahs.e2: Those ˹maidens˺ will be ˹as elegant˺ as rubies and coral

ayahs.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.e2: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.en: Is the reward for good [anything] but good
ayahs.e2: Is there any reward for goodness except goodness

ayahs.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.e2: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.en: And below them both [in excellence] are two [other] gardens
ayahs.e2: And below these two ˹Gardens˺ will be two others

ayahs.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.e2: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.en: Dark green [in color]
ayahs.e2: Both will be dark green

ayahs.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.e2: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.en: In both of them are two springs, spouting
ayahs.e2: In each will be two gushing springs

ayahs.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.e2: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.en: In both of them are fruit and palm trees and pomegranates
ayahs.e2: In both will be fruit, palm trees, and pomegranates
ayahs.tr: Feehimaa faakihatunw wa nakhlunw wa rummaan

ayahs.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.e2: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.en: In them are good and beautiful women
ayahs.e2: In all Gardens will be noble, pleasant mates

ayahs.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.e2: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.en: Fair ones reserved in pavilions
ayahs.e2: ˹They will be˺ maidens with gorgeous eyes, reserved in pavilions

ayahs.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.e2: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.ar: لَمۡ يَطۡمِثۡهُنَّ إِنسࣱ قَبۡلَهُمۡ وَلَا جَآنࣱّ‏
ayahs.en: Untouched before them by man or jinni
ayahs.e2: No human or jinn has ever touched these ˹maidens˺ before
ayahs.tr: Lam yatmis hunna insun qablahum wa laa jaaann

ayahs.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.e2: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.ar: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ رَفۡرَفٍ خُضۡرࣲ وَعَبۡقَرِيٍّ حِسَانࣲ‏
ayahs.en: Reclining on green cushions and beautiful fine carpets
ayahs.e2: All ˹believers˺ will be reclining on green cushions and splendid carpets

ayahs.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
ayahs.e2: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.ar: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱسۡمُ رَبِّكَ ذِي ٱلۡجَلَٰلِ وَٱلۡإِكۡرَامِ
ayahs.en: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor
ayahs.e2: Blessed is the Name of your Lord, full of Majesty and Honour
